label: Complete lists matching the endless supplier prefix
definition: On the common natural-number roster, every recipient x below the audit length has complete incoming list consisting of x + 1 alone. The audit uses the same identities, begins at recipient zero and follows the indicated suppliers; length zero records no lists.
note: Uses SupplierAudit.auditFrame with the selected prefix of recipients. The observed rootless prefix is a record of complete incoming lists at those recipients, with no claim about a list beyond the audit.
